fusions.name: Hundredth Pace
fusions.desc: A running kick on a target up to 3 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 30%). Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Sweeping Heel
fusions.desc: A low sweep that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and takes their feet from under them, which stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Keep the Cadence
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage and fights with 1 more power for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Shorter Roads
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 12%. Your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
